messages:
Eli (AE): Heads-up — Mercury Labs sent back the MSA with redlines and a short PO note. They want the POC to start Mon. Can legal + ops triage?
Ruth (Legal): Drop the redline file here and call out must-fix items. Is Mercury asking to change payment terms or termination?
Eli (AE): File: https://files.internal/mercury/msa_redline_031.json. Key asks: (a) liability cap set to 6 months revenue, (b) remove auto-renew, (c) DPA: process EU data only + requester-managed keys, (d) SLA lowered to 99.5%.
Ruth (Legal): Thanks. Quick take: liability cap — we'll negotiate to 3 months on Hosted, 6 months might be acceptable for Dedicated with exec signoff. Auto-renew — we can make it explicit opt-in for this enterprise. SLA — we target 99.9% for Dedicated; can soften credits. DPA — needs security confirmation on key handling.
Omar (Security): For EU-only processing we can support region-restriction on Dedicated or Private. Hosted can be region-locked but requires DPA + clear assurances on backups. Customer-managed keys (BYOK) is supported, but onboarding work needed. Will need statement in contract: "Customer is responsible for provisioning and rotating their KMS keys; Redwood will not have access to plaintext keys."
Marco (Finance): Procurement asks Net45 instead of Net30. Also want invoice to reference their internal cost center. Any discount considerations? Current POC discount is 25% for first 90 days.
Tanya (SalesOps): I can prepare an order form with routing. Who signs on Redwood side? Also need canonical SOW filename.
Eli (AE): SOW: SOW-MERC-2026-v3.pdf in deal folder. Signers on our side: AE (me) + Legal (Ruth). Customer signers: Head of Security then Procurement Director. They prefer DocuSign.
Jin (SE): Tech note: POC uses Dedicated nodes, with KV cache + ephemeral storage. Recommend adding a data-retention clause: `All POC customer data stored by Redwood will be purged within 21 days of POC end, unless otherwise agreed.` Also add a KMS handoff step in onboarding plan.
Ruth (Legal): Good. I'll draft redline that: (1) Counters 6mo cap to 3mo for Hosted, accepts 6mo for Dedicated with exec approval; (2) adds Jin's 21-day purge language; (3) swaps auto-renew for explicit renewal with 30-day notice; (4) SLA at 99.9% with defined credits table.
Eli (AE): Procurement also asked about PO before signatures — they prefer we sign first and they'll issue PO after. Is that okay?
Marco (Finance): We prefer to receive PO before provisioning but can accept PO post-signature for strategic accounts. We'll flag billing contact and PO acceptance. Net45 needs approval from FP&A — I can confirm by EOD.
Tanya (SalesOps): Creating DocuSign envelope now. Routing: Customer Security -> Procurement -> Eli -> Ruth. CC billing@redwood.com. Envelope link will be posted.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created by Tanya (SalesOps): ID a1b2c3  route: sec@mercury.co -> procurement@mercury.co -> eli@redwood.com -> ruth@redwood.com. Link: https://docusign.internal/envelope/a1b2c3
Eli (AE): Also note they asked to put SLA credits example table directly on the order form so procurement can see exact refunds. Ruth, can you add that?
Ruth (Legal): Yes, will insert a simple table: < 99.9% = 10% credit, < 99% = 25% credit, material outage clause excluded. Tanya, ensure table fits on order form PDF.
Omar (Security): Uploaded SOC2 summary + KMS integration checklist: https://files.internal/mercury/sec-summ.zip. Note: Mercury insists on no cross-region backups; confirm ops can enforce.
Jin (SE): Ops can enforce region locking for Dedicated. KMS provisioning requires coordination; estimate 3 business days after signed contract to complete KMS key exchange and config.
Marco (Finance): FP&A approved Net45 for this account. They also need the invoice remittance details: `Mercury Labs / AP / ap@mercury.co`.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope a1b2c3: Signed by Customer Security @1769456899. Awaiting Customer Procurement.
Eli (AE): Security signed — nice. Procurement expected tomorrow morning. I'll tell Mercury we can kick provisioning after final exec signature + PO (per finance).
Tanya (SalesOps): Small change: Mercury asked to add a one-time onboarding credit line on the order form. I added placeholder $0 until we confirm.
Ruth (Legal): Uploaded redline: https://files.internal/mercury/msa_redline_ruth_v1.docx. Major edits highlighted per thread.
Eli (AE): Customer replied: "We can sign now, procurement will attach PO within 48 hours. DocuSign preferred."
DocuSign Bot: Envelope a1b2c3: Signed by Customer Procurement @1769456982. Now routed to Eli.
Eli (AE): Signed by me @1769456990. Tanya, please get final countersign from Ruth.
Ruth (Legal): Countersigned and executed @1769457005. Please archive executed PDF and trigger provisioning ticket.
Jin (SE): Received executed contract link. I'll open onboarding ticket and set target: Provision Dedicated nodes + KMS setup ETA 5 business days.
Eli (AE): Great job team. I'll send handoff to CS + confirm PO when Mercury uploads. :white_check_mark:
